Title: Sr. AI/ML Engineer (MXC)
Description: Do work that matters. At AlertMedia , we help organizations protect their people, operations, and brand. Our modern Risk Intelligence and Response platform empowers teams to detect emerging threats, assess impact, and respond with confidence. We believe building resilience should be simpler—and it starts with bringing critical information and workflows together in one unified platform. Our core values drive us in our important mission of keeping people safe & informed: We’re humans not robots Customers always come first We work better together Simplicity is our strength Our reputation is priceless Hard work pays off AlertMedia is looking for an innovative and hands-on Sr. AI/ML Engineer with a strong background in applied machine learning and data science to lead the evaluation, training, and integration of advanced AI and machine learning models across our product suite. In this role, you will help shape our AI strategy by identifying the most appropriate models for our use cases, optimizing their performance through fine-tuning and prompt engineering, and ensuring their responsible deployment within our platforms. You will have the opportunity to show who you are throughout our interview process; we don’t ask any trick questions or expect you to perform a whiteboard exercise. We want to see you shine by showing us work you are most proud of! Who you are: You are an applied AI and machine learning engineer with strong data science fundamentals, deeply curious about what's possible with large language models and practical machine learning applications. You’re a collaborative engineer who thrives in a fast-moving environment, and you’re as comfortable training and fine-tuning models as you are crafting prompts or evaluating model outputs. You have a strong understanding of ML fundamentals, but you're pragmatic in applying the right solution for the problem. What you get to do every day: Train and fine-tune supervised learning models (e.g., classification, ranking, embeddings) for internal tools and customer-facing product features. Lead prompt engineering and testing efforts to fine-tune LLM behavior for specific use cases across the product suite. Design and implement evaluation pipelines for both LLMs and traditional ML models. Work with and optimize Elasticsearch-backed data systems that power AI and intelligence pipelines. Proactively identify opportunities to improve AI models, data pipelines, and engineering workflows beyond the existing roadmap. Develop tools and frameworks to support prompt iteration, model benchmarking, and performance tracking. Coordinate with security team to ensure adherence to AI compliance standards. Evaluate and compare commercial and open-source LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Meta, etc.) for performance, cost, alignment, and reliability. Collaborate with product and engineering teams to integrate AI features in a safe, scalable, and maintainable way. Monitor, evaluate, and continuously improve the performance of AI and machine learning models in production. Stay informed of emerging research in NLP, machine learning, and AI infrastructure, and evaluate potential applications for the business. Contribute to AlertMedia’s culture, values and vision for the future. What you bring to the role: Bachelor’s degree in a technical field such as computer science, computer engineering or related field preferred. 5+ years of software engineering experience, Python preferred. 4+ years of experience in data science and/or software engineering, specifically in machine learning engineering, or applied AI. Strong understanding of LLMs and traditional machine learning methods. Experience with prompt engineering, model fine-tuning, and evaluation. Familiarity with model evaluation best practices, including offline metrics, cross-validation, and A/B testing. Proficiency in Python and ML libraries (e.g., scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face). Experience working with Elasticsearch or other large-scale search and indexing platforms. Experience with cloud-based ML tooling (e.g., SageMaker, Bedrock) and data workflows. Demonstrated experience training and deploying supervised learning models, ideally in production environments (a plus). Ability to work independently and collaboratively on cross-functional teams. Strong organizational skills and ability to manage working on multiple projects in parallel. The ability and desire to work in a fast-paced challenging environment. Location: This position is remote based in Mexico. Must reside in Mexico and we have an office in Mexico City (Reforma area), if you're interested in going into the office. Not required, but optional. Sponsorship: AlertMedia does not sponsor employment visas. Candidates must have existing authorization to work in Mexico without the need for sponsorship now or in the future. Identity Verification: To protect our candidates and our company from hiring fraud, finalists may be asked to complete an identity verification and present valid government-issued identification before or during the hiring process. By applying, you acknowledge that all interviews and assessments must be completed by you and not by another individual acting on your behalf. Why you’ll love working at AlertMedia: At AlertMedia, you won’t just build your career — you’ll be part of something meaningful, surrounded by people who genuinely care about the work and each other. Competitive Base Salary (Bi-Monthly payroll) Annual Company Bonus 100% Employer-Paid Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage Parental Leave Program Christmas Bonus (Aguinaldo) Generous Vacation and Holiday Policy Additional Vacation Bonus Monthly Work-from-Home Stipend All Necessary Equipment Provided: Laptop, monitor and accessories Recognition & Rewards: We celebrate wins big and small Language Immersion Program with employees spread out across the globe (English, Spanish, etc...depending on your interest) Continuous Learning & Growth: From mentorship and tech talks to personalized 1:1 career development sessions, we’re deeply committed to investing in your professional journey Award Winning Culture: We're proud to be recognized as a BEST WORKPLACE FOR 10 YEARS IN A ROW The Work & People: We’re passionate about the meaningful work we do—and even more grateful for the incredible people we get to do it with! About AlertMedia: We are the leading risk intelligence and response platform — trusted by the largest companies in the world to protect their people and assets when it matters most. We are a high-growth, PE-backed SaaS company with more than 4,000 clients scaling rapidly across the globe. Our technology is unmatched with a unified platform, a 7+year history of AI innovation, a customer NPS of 70+, and a culture that sets us even further apart from our competition. We are an equal opportunity employer focused on creating a collaborative and exciting place for all to work. Ensuring a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace for all people is key to our success and core to our values.   All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. This is an amazing opportunity to be part of our wave of momentum and take our company, and your career, to the next growth stage. We'd love to get to know you better and share how we serve our amazing customers. For more information, please visit www.alertmedia.com. Come join us in our mission to save lives and minimize loss through effective communication. Are you passionate about bringing rigor to how early-stage businesses measure and optimize acquisition spend from day one? If so, we encourage you to apply! This person will define the metrics that matter, measure channel and campaign performance, and develop reports that drive decisions. This role partners closely with the Business Analyst, New Businesses and the Senior Business Analyst focused on acquisitions, ensuring marketing performance insights are integrated with the broader business and revenue picture. We expect that we not only answer the question asked, but also the question that was not. This Marketing Analyst needs to build positive relationships across the organization, manage diverse stakeholders with competing and often conflicting priorities, and have a “find a way” attitude. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. Build, own, and maintain the marketing data infrastructure, from ad impression and click through lead acquisition to revenue, setting up and integrating Google Analytics, Google Ads, and other paid advertising platforms as required. Rapidly assess and integrate the marketing data of newly acquired (M&A) companies, establishing tracking, attribution, and reporting so their acquisition spend is measured with the same rigor as the rest of Toptal. Measure and diagnose paid advertising performance across channels and businesses—analyzing spend efficiency, CAC, funnel conversion, lead value, ROAS, and LTV—to guide budget allocation and channel strategy. Define metrics that are independent, holistic, accurate, encourage the right behaviors, and are aligned with company strategy and objectives, including consistent definitions of LTV, ROAS, and payback across businesses. Use descriptive (what happened) and diagnostic (why did it happen) analytics to develop specific, actionable recommendations for marketing leaders and business owners. Partner closely with the Business Analyst, New Businesses and the Senior Business Analyst focused on acquisitions to connect marketing performance with revenue, unit economics, and the broader business picture. Map marketing processes and channel journeys to their corresponding data flows across acquisition, engagement, and revenue generation. Proactively identify and surface opportunities to improve efficiency, conversion, revenue generation, client and talent experience, operations, communication, systems & tools, cash usage, etc. Leverage Generative AI tools to accelerate analysis and automate reporting workflows. Qualifications and Job Requirements: Bachelor’s degree is required. 3+ years of experience in data analysis, analytics, or business intelligence is required, with a focus on marketing analytics. Demonstrated experience analyzing paid advertising performance (e.g., Google Ads and other paid media platforms) and translating it into metrics such as LTV, CAC, and ROAS is required. Demonstrated experience building or owning marketing data infrastructure (tracking, attribution, data pipelines, and reporting) is required. Both a strong background in math, science, finance, engineering, or statistics and deep business insight is required; advanced degrees and/or MBA are a plus. Experience with BI tools (Tableau, Qlik, PowerBI, etc.). Proficiency in SQL; experience with R, Python, or MATLAB is a plus. Hands-on experience using Generative AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT to support analysis, automation, and reporting. Experience with exploratory data analysis, prototyping, testing hypotheses, performing root cause analyses, modeling business processes, building forecasts, creating predictive models, defining metrics, and/or measuring marketing performance. Track record of linking data and analytics to marketing strategy, financial performance, and operations to drive real impact. Working knowledge of probability and statistics, experience with process improvement is a plus. Experience in a startup, early-stage business, or M&A integration environment is a plus. Proven ability to manage diverse stakeholders and balance multiple, conflicting priorities in a fast-moving environment. Ability to explain complex issues simply and intuitively, and willingness to challenge assumptions, communicate limitations, and flag blind spots. The ideal candidate needs to have a strong technical background particularly when it comes to marketing data infrastructure and Google products (Google Analytics, Google Ads) while having the ability to master marketing processes of diverse nature. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts. You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Title: Simulation Technical Expert
Description: Job Description The individual will need to use and be comfortable operating in MATLAB, Dassault and Siemens signature flagship platforms to manage model configurations and maintain synchronized, traceable connectivity between CAD, PLM, and CAE/CFD tools, while building, correlating, and optimizing finite element models against standardized load cases and boundary conditions aligned with program checkpoints to drive performance, weight, and durability outcomes. This role will also serve as the core simulation expert supporting the Mechatronic Systems team, acting as the go-to technical SME to develop and facilitate simulation needs and ensure mechatronic feature decisions are grounded in rigorous, well-validated simulation data. A core expectation of this position will be supporting the development and writing of advanced scripts and macros, that become reusable tools for global rollout of simulation processes across the broader organisation as the industry moves toward software-based verification. Responsibilities In this position, you will: Simulation Technical Authority (Generative AI and MDAO): Act as the subject matter expert for adopting generative AI and multidisciplinary design optimization (MDAO) in simulation workflows. Move the team beyond manual use of commercial software toward automated, data-driven analysis and design exploration. Advanced CAE/CFD Analysis: Support System of Interest projects with subsystem- and vehicle-level analysis. Use Dassault 3DEXPERIENCE, Siemens platforms, Altair HyperWorks, Inspire/SimSolid, LS-DYNA, ADAMS and MATLAB to meet NVH, Vehicle Dynamics, and Durability KPIs, along with weight and performance targets. Proprietary Method and Algorithm Development: Develop proprietary algorithms and translation methods that convert data between disparate data sets and solvers. These methods must account for differences between static and dynamic load cases so that simulation results stay consistent across analysis conditions. Reusable Tools and Global Rollout: Support the development and writing of advanced scripts, macros, and automation pipelines. Turn them into standardized, reusable tools that enable global rollout of simulation processes across the organization as the industry moves toward software-based verification. Model Management and Traceability: Use MATLAB and the Dassault and Siemens flagship platforms to manage model configurations. Maintain synchronized, traceable connectivity between CAD, PLM, and CAE/CFD tools. Build, correlate, and optimize finite element models against standardized load cases and boundary conditions aligned with program checkpoints. System Optimization and Trade Studies: Optimize vehicle systems across cost, weight, and performance using tools such as ModeFRONTIER, 3DX Abaqus/Tosca, and Altair OptiStruct. Run MDO and sensitivity analyses to inform system selection. Mechatronics Simulation Expertise: Serve as the core simulation SME for the Mechatronic Systems team. Develop and facilitate their simulation needs so that mechatronic feature decisions rest on rigorous, well-validated data. Requirements Validation: Confirm that system requirements are applicable. Challenge requirements that lack clear legacy reasoning, and verify that system concepts are supported by simulation data. Create test roadmaps with clear hypotheses, control groups, success metrics, guardrails, and decision rules. Use A/B testing, holdouts, incrementality testing, customer research, and behavioral analysis to assess true impact. Turn results into documented learnings, optimization actions, and reusable growth principles. Promote rapid learning while protecting customer experience, brand standards, privacy, and operational quality. Digital commerce and conversion Partner with Digital Commerce and Product teams to improve subscription purchase, vehicle attach, conversion, onboarding, and post-purchase engagement. Connect acquisition and lifecycle programs to subscription revenue, customer value, and retention outcomes—not only engagement metrics.
